name: Formula Student Rules 2027 v1.0 (FSG) with FSUK 2027 v1.0 supplement
note: Aero geometry limits for Wing Lab. Values are data, not code: edit or add a file for a new season. Distances are relative to the car's own reference points (tyres, head restraint), so they become a box only once the car geometry is known.

forward_of_front_tyre_leading_edge_max.rule: FS T8.2.1, forward of the vertical plane through the front tyres' leading edge

rearward_of_head_restraint_max.rule: FS T8.2.1, rearward of the rearmost point of the front face of the head restraint support, set fully rearward, padding excluded

elsewhere_max.value: top of the nearer side's tyres

ground_clearance_min.rule: FS T2.2.1, static, any part other than tyres, driver seated

below_tyre_top_rear_of_front_leading_edg.value: inside the plane touching the outermost points of front and rear wheel/tyre

700_to_1100_max.value: not outboard of the rear wheel/tyre's outermost point

around_tyres_side_view.rule: FS T2.1.3, in front of and behind each tyre, outboard of the tyre's inboard plane

front_variable_cuboids.rule: FS T2.1.4, two 75 x 250 mm cuboids on the ground ahead of the front tyres

conditions.value: wheels straight, any suspension setup, with or without driver

distributed_load.value: 200 N over at least 225 cm2, at most 10 mm deflection

point_load.value: 50 N any direction, at most 25 mm deflection

fsuk_reduced_test_load.value: a lower load (e.g. 100 N) may be used, deflection limits scaled

fsuk_uncontrolled_movement.value: large, uncontrolled movement on track: black flag with orange circle, excluded until fixed

no_ground_contact.value: no sliding skirts or devices touching the track

no_fans_under_vehicle.value: no powered device moving air from under the car

verified: 2026-11-06 against both PDFs: FS T2.1.3, T2.1.4, T2.2, T2.4.1, T8.2, T8.3 word for word. FS 2027 v1.0 changed T8.2.1 (height) and T8.2.2 (width) from 2026; the values here are the 2027 ones. FSUK 2027 v1.0 takes T8 as FS 2027 except T8.1.2, T8.3.3, T8.3.4 and T8.4.5, and amends T2 only at T2.6 to T2.8, so the geometry limits are the same at both events.
